
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lulight/p/19072390" title="发布于 2025-09-03 20:13">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【App Service】在Azure环境中如何查看App Service实例当前的网络连接情况呢？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>问题描述</h1>
<p>在使用 Azure App Service（Windows 和 Linux）部署应用时，如何分析网络连接情况，尤其是查看特定端口（如 443, 3306, 6380等）的连接状态？这对于排查连接异常、验证服务是否正常监听端口、确认后端服务是否建立连接等场景非常关键。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="364" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202509/2127802-20250903195307254-786989443.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>在本地环境中，可以使用netstat命令来查看网络连接状态。但是，在App Service 云环境中，是否还可以使用netstat命令呢？</p>
<blockquote>
<div data-testid="loading-message" data-fui-focus-visible="">
<div id="chatMessageResponserju" class="___1yop6mf f336tjw f9ijwd5 fz7g6wx fod5ikn f1s184ao">
<div class="___1j4t0a1 f1lmfglv f1abmfm4" data-testid="markdown-reply" data-message-type="Chat">
<div class="___stpibi0 f22iagw f1vx9l62 fk15e71 f1k953kz f137keqj f1rncccw f1stllg3 f1w4kmmc f1tric3v f10dk5ic fx8cdsv f16nlwsl f1eookvz fhjrts3 fqugt2f f10km5jb f18d18k8 f1v1vhmp f1hdmul3 f198vjnp f2dshw1 fjpjndq fnmj2pj ffrrb40 f1mon110 fhajzam fimndk6 fxv4dng fb1rn9k f59wlhv f1xmfh30 f18yf5o5 fmr6chf fw8qy2q ff161sd f1qr7t77 f1yyogn1 foogchg fp5872b f1tpb8gf f1hdgrc8 f1vatr43 frkxccd f9pdzkb f158oiaz ft5kggy f5l4ui7 f13j03li f18xdoka f8off4e f1go6zfc f128n2ra f1jpxw2j f1lwd9n0 fy0b8hm f1g2633v fx4kvgi fkvolse f1gxrt3a f1os76ua f1js9cnw f1g87ej0 freluf8 f1yggaq6 f2i3chp f1151osp florpoh f35kzfz ftp9m57 f1e288vi fz62hnz fixvuys f1nmofwh fc1c6mv f18a2er7 fhvkrdl fhxnn68 f1oce4bo fvhlfan f7tc0t0 f1ngf1n2 ffrzq6x f1yjiq2m f1aqdgql f1huvaf f10ij78l f1k94sa4 fkmfumq f1jvzkyl f1eu24ob f1xbfc1f fmf0lwf f107dsy8 f3w566c f4648sl f13zpkng f7unjfp f8p1rz fzu6h1w f1i1bi6h f1smo7hi f1sk1xod f1kgogdq f1gjktkp ft608jz f19dd9cz fg3xr24 fhd155k f1b8gl2e fg4b9ou flb4lo fdicbfk fgwcyh1 f1jbds0d f1fb9uea f1stuka4 fcrtu6g fwqh0xn f11w66yg f6e0e65 f1vvgu0 f1607507 f1m9bycv f1ntoah8 f1b694rt faql4r2 fpjuhzh fmavl6h">
<p><code>netstat</code> 是一个用于显示网络连接、路由表、接口状态等信息的命令行工具。它可用于诊断网络问题，查看端口是否被监听、连接是否建立，以及对应的进程信息。适用于 Windows 和 Linux 系统。</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</blockquote>
<h1>问题解答</h1>
<p>可以使用 <code>netstat</code> 命令在 App Service 的容器或Linux实例中查看端口连接情况， 但是在Windows环境中被禁用。</p>
<h2>✅ 在 Linux App Service 中：</h2>
<p>使用如下命令：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">netstat -anp | grep 443</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li><code>-a</code>：显示所有连接和监听端口。</li>
<li><code>-n</code>：以数字形式显示地址和端口。</li>
<li><code>-p</code>：显示关联的进程 ID 和名称。</li>
<li><code>grep 443</code>：过滤出使用 443 端口的连接。</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="249" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202509/2127802-20250903195559320-2034392230.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;如图所示，输出结果中显示多个 TCP 连接，状态为 <code>ESTABLISHED</code>，说明这些连接已成功建立，且由进程 <code>329/java</code> 处理。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>✅ 在 Windows App Service 中：</h2>
<p>在Kudu的CMD中使用命令：netstat -ano | findstr 443</p>
<p>或者在Powershell中使用命令：Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 443</p>
<p>都是Access is Denied。两个指令都被禁用了。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="190" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202509/2127802-20250903200140730-1288103027.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>所以App Service for Windows 环境中，没有直接的方式可以查看到当前的网络连接情况。只有通过App Service 指标Connections来进行辅助判断。&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="289" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202509/2127802-20250903200600687-1182204875.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>PS: App Service for Windows 可以通过门户上抓取网络包，这样可以更全面的分析网络状态。</p>
<p>页面导航：App Service 门户 --&gt; Networking页面 --&gt;页面上的“Troubleshoot” 按钮 --&gt; Collect Network Trace</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="381" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202509/2127802-20250903200952638-250499355.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>附录</h1>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>Window环境中netstat命令说明</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>C:\&gt;netstat -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">help

Displays protocol statistics and current TCP</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">IP network connections.

NETSTAT [</span>-a] [-b] [-e] [-f] [-i] [-n] [-o] [-p proto] [-r] [-s] [-t] [-x] [-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">y] [interval]

  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">a            Displays all connections and listening ports.
  </span>-b            Displays the executable involved <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> creating each connection or
                listening port. In some cases well</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">known executables host
                multiple independent components, and </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> these cases the
                sequence of components involved </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> creating the connection
                or listening port </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> displayed. In <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> the executable
                name </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> [] at the bottom, on top <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> the component it called,
                and so forth until TCP</span>/IP was reached. Note that <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> option
                can be time</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">consuming and will fail unless you have sufficient
                permissions.
  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">c            Displays a list of processes sorted by the number of TCP or UDP
                ports currently consumed.
  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">d            Displays DSCP value assocated with each connection.
  </span>-e            Displays Ethernet statistics. This may be combined with the -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">s
                option.
  </span>-f            Displays Fully Qualified Domain Names (FQDN) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> foreign
                addresses.
  </span>-i            Displays the time spent by a TCP connection <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> its current state.
  </span>-n            Displays addresses and port numbers <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> numerical form.
  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">o            Displays the owning process ID associated with each connection.
  </span>-p proto      Shows connections <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> the protocol specified by proto; proto
                may be any of: TCP, UDP, TCPv6, or UDPv6.  If used with the </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">s
                option to display per</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">protocol statistics, proto may be any of:
                IP, IPv6, ICMP, ICMPv6, TCP, TCPv6, UDP, or UDPv6.
  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">q            Displays all connections, listening ports, and bound
                nonlistening TCP ports. Bound nonlistening ports may or may not
                be associated with an active connection.
  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">r            Displays the routing table.
  </span>-s            Displays per-protocol statistics.  By <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, statistics are
                shown </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IP, IPv6, ICMP, ICMPv6, TCP, TCPv6, UDP, and UDPv6;
                the </span>-p option may be used to specify a subset of the <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.
  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">t            Displays the current connection offload state.
  </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">x            Displays NetworkDirect connections, listeners, and shared
                endpoints.
  </span>-y            Displays the TCP connection template <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> all connections.
                Cannot be combined with the other options.
  interval      Redisplays selected statistics, pausing interval seconds
                between each display.  Press CTRL</span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">C to stop redisplaying
                statistics.  If omitted, netstat will print the current
                configuration information once.</span></pre>
</div>
